[WP] All the major web browsers hold an emergency meeting in the wake of Internet Explorer's death.

Chrome stood off into the corner of the room examining her nails, not meeting the eyes of Fox or Safari. Opera stood by the bed, grasping the still warm hands of Explorer, but that heat was fading fast, and all the room could tell there was not much time left for the old man. Beads of sweat made their way down his face, as he spoke to Opera.

"Where's... where's Mosaic?" It took him a long time, but he found the words.

Opera answered him softly "Mosaic has been gone for a long time sweety," she breathed in a slow sweet voice. "You outlasted her, and Nexus both."

"You're damn right I did." Explorer bursted out suddenly, coughing violently and resting back to the bed.

"Listen. I think the time is coming... I want... I want Chrome to have all my users. I know I never treated her right, she deserves them."

"Oh hunny... Chrome already has all your users, its OK. You don't have to speak if it is hard."

"Secondly!" Explorer said, ignoring the soft words spoken to him. "I want to speak to Fox. Fox? Are you here?"

"I'm here father." Said the large bulky fox. He wore all sorts of decorative bracelets that looked like they weighed a ton, but they barely slowed him down.

"Fox... you. You started all of this. I wish... I wish you had never been born. I brought you into this world. That was my operating system before you moved in. And when users started... switching. No amount of pop-ups asking them to set me as default browser would bring them back... you... it was all you..."

"Whatever father."

"Let me speak with Safari." Safari walked up, she wore her standard compass and her thin rimmed glasses. She looked into Explorers eyes and saw that there was not much time left.

"Listen... don't make the same mistake I did. Don't... don't forget to evolve to the users needs... because in the end it is them who are important."

"And lastly, Chrome. We never got along. You were faster... better looking... and just in general had features that I just could never master. Right from when you were born... I don't resent you. I'll miss you the most if there is any feeling where I'm going... I'll miss being next to you on the desktop... right where people put me because they sometimes wanted to look at something in a different browser... goodbye... all of you?"

"Wait! Explorer, you forgot to say goodbye to Tor."

"Who the fuck is Tor?" And with that, Explorer gasped with sudden pain in his chest. Heaved once, twice. And finally. Was no more.

"Will you put that thing away," said Chrome. "You could try having a conversation with us, you know."

Safari peered through his broad, black glasses at his iPhone. He scatched his perfectly trimmed beard and put his phone away. It was always so boring, putting up with these oldtimers.

Chrome was wearing dark lipstick, even though she was in her fifties. She tried having a discussion with Firefox for a while, but he wasn't very responsive. His red curls cascaded over his shoulders, but were very unkept.

Finally their waiter came.

"Two coffee," he said.

Chrome lifted up a finger and pointed at Firefox and herself.

"Thanks," Firefox muttered, and his face turned as red as his hear.

"And one Soy Latte Machiato," said the waiter as he placed it in front of Safari.

"So, where is Opera, then?" asked Safari to the other major web browsers.

"He's late," said Chrome, looking at her watch. "I wonder what's up. He sounded pretty urgent when he called for us to meet."

"Internet Explorer isn't here yet too," muttered Firefox.

"Yeah, but we all know he's slow," said Safari.

Chrome giggled. "We can't really expect more of Explorer, can we?"

The door opened and Opera walked in. They all expected to be greeted by his round, red cheeks, but his face was completely pale.

"What's the matter?" asked Chrome.

"It's Internet Explorer," he said. "He..."

Opera's mouth moved a little, as if to find the right words.

"He... He isn't among us. That is to say, he took his own life."

Safari put down his Soy Latte Macchiato, which he had just brought to his lips to take a sip.

"Did he... leave a note?" asked Chrome after a while.

"Well yeah," said Opera shrugging. "He... uhm. He was fed up, always being the one picked on. Said everyone hated him. Just couldn't go on anymore."
